{{Top|leg}}
'''Star Tours Flight 915''' was the designation of a [[Star Tours/Legends|Star Tours]] travel agency flight to [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]] just before the [[Raid at Spaceport THX1138]]. The flight arrived at the spaceport's gate 2B at 0620 hours, and the gate was closed in preparation for its scheduled departure at 0715.
